Paragraph:
Translation: For, if I did not engage in work, O Partha, certainly all men would follow My path.

Purport (Excerpt): In order to keep the balance of social tranquility... there are traditional family usages meant for every civilized man. Although such rules and regulations are for the conditioned souls and not Lord Krsna... He followed the prescribed rules. Otherwise, common men would follow in His footsteps...
Situation/Problem_Faced: The risk of setting a dangerous precedent if a central figure refrains from performing standard responsibilities.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna explains that if He stopped working, people would copy His inaction and abandon their own duties, causing social breakdown.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna realizes that his personal choice to fight or abandon the battlefield carries wide public consequences.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Awareness of Social Impact: Recognizing how one's actions set a precedent for others
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Responsibility to Society: Upholding duties to preserve community structure and well-being
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Preventing Social Inertia: Avoiding behaviors that encourage passive withdrawal in others

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Mamavartmanuvartante (People following the path or precedent set by the Lord)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna explains that if He were to cease performing activities, humanity would imitate His withdrawal and abandon their obligatory duties, throwing spiritual and social order into chaos.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Our actions do not happen in a vacuum; choices to withdraw, shirk responsibility, or indulge in unhealthy habits can influence family and peers to do the same. Being mindful of your influence encourages accountability and healthy social boundaries.
